answer.title: Daily Reminder Calls
answer.trigger: Triggered every working day at 16:00 to process reminder calls.
steps: Fetch the list of customers scheduled for a reminder call today from the phone system.
Generate a reminder message for each customer.
Place the automated reminder calls via the phone system.
answer.ai_help: Generate the reminder call script or message content.
answer.risk_reason: Making a mistake simply means a customer receives an incorrect reminder call time, which can be easily corrected.
